name: job-hunter
description: Let Claude add jobs to your local Job Hunter Board.
long_description: Adds a single tool, add_job, which adds a job position to the Board of the Job Hunter account that owns the integration token, optionally with an already-calculated job-fit evaluation that Job Hunter shows as an External AI match. Talks only to your own Job Hunter backend.

tools.name: add_job
tools.description: Add one job position to your Job Hunter Board (duplicates are detected by Job Hunter). Optionally include an already-calculated job-fit evaluation (fitScore, matchingSkills, missingSkills, concerns, evaluationModel).

base_url.title: Job Hunter backend URL
base_url.description: Where your Job Hunter backend runs. Locally this is http://localhost:8080.

token.title: Job Hunter integration token
token.description: Generate it in Job Hunter: Settings > Claude / MCP > Generate token. It is stored in your macOS Keychain.
